subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects land now as fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR pause until the broader reattach-first design is chosen?
rationale: Both paths are defensible: this PR fixes the same-session transcript collision with a small change, but it preserves possible duplicate model/tool/delivery side effects that the related reattach-first issue aims to remove.

options.title: Land the focused fallback
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and treat reattach-first recovery as follow-up work.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this branch to wait for the accepted gateway run before recooking locally, accepting a larger stdout/streaming behavior change.

options.title: Pause pending product direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers decide the disconnect recovery policy in the related issue.

recommendation.title: Land the focused fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and treat reattach-first recovery as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership signal across the CLI gateway path and adjacent session-state work.
